units.source_text: ……我们做梦也没有想到海军的逃兵竟然逃到这个村庄里。

en.t: ... We never dreamed that a deserter from the navy had actually fled into this village.

units.source_text: 晌午时分，宪兵到村公所来了。

en.t: Around noon, the military police came to the village office.

units.source_text: 但是宪兵的到来并不稀奇，也就不觉得问题的严重性。

en.t: But the arrival of the military police was nothing unusual, so we did not sense how serious the matter was.
